New sessions remove identifying metadata by default. This also removes GPS, dates, camera details and author fields; visible image content is unchanged.

Preservation is best effort for PNG and lossless WebP: capture/digitization dates and time offsets, camera and lens make/model, artist/copyright, GPS latitude/longitude/altitude. Printable ASCII fields up to 512 characters only. Missing, invalid or unsupported values may be omitted. Orientation and dimensions are regenerated. MakerNote, serial numbers, thumbnails, comments, arbitrary XMP/IPTC and source paths are never copied. This can reveal your location or identity. HEIC/AVIF/JXL preservation is unavailable.

Choose images or share them to FixMyShot from another app. Select a destination or ratio, review the preview and export new copies. PNG is the default. Lossless WebP is also available. Settings can apply to the whole batch or only the selected image. On Android 10 or later, copies are saved in Pictures/FixMyShot. Older versions ask for a folder. Select saved images in the results to share them. If a previous export needs review, check its results before starting another.

Images are processed on your device. FixMyShot has no network permission, account or analytics. Original files are read only. Identifying metadata is removed from new copies by default. You can explicitly preserve the supported fields in Review, including GPS and author details. Private working copies may remain until you discard the session, reopen the app for age-based cleanup, clear app data or uninstall. External image providers may use the network independently. Links below open an external browser only when you choose them.

Keep this existing copy as a successful result? FixMyShot will check its bytes again and record your confirmation. It will not create another copy. A hidden, changed, missing or unreadable output cannot be accepted.

The action could not be completed. The output may be missing, changed, hidden or inaccessible, no viewer may be available, or private cleanup may be blocked by another pending job. Review the results and try again.

Finish reviewing when you no longer need to restore or retry this export. Its private recovery settings will be removed; saved copies and output receipts remain. Discard the session to remove its remaining working copies.

Runs five small synthetic AVIF cases with odd and aligned dimensions, with grid on and off. No personal images are read, and no files are published. Android decoders may share a backend. This numeric check never enables AVIF export.

Share the numeric report if you choose. It contains device and app versions, an APK hash and synthetic measurements, but no photo or encoded image bytes.
